key.name: calendar-uid
key.description: The UID of the Evolution Data Server calendar source to show events from. Use 'ALL' to show events from all calendars.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Where to place the indicator in the top panel, anchored to real panel elements rather than a raw index.

key.name: max-title-length
key.description: Maximum number of characters for the event title before truncating.

key.name: refresh-interval-seconds
key.description: How often to check for upcoming events, in seconds.
